title: Nebbos automations manifest (.nebbos/automations.yaml)
description: One file per repo. Declares every automation the repo owns so the automation registry learns about it in the PR that adds it (tasks AUT-61, AUT-62).

repo.description: Repository name without the org, e.g. nebos-billing.

slug.description: <repo-short>.<kebab-name>; repo-short is the repo name minus a nebos-/nebbos- prefix.

schedule.description: Cron expression in UTC, or null.

expected_interval_minutes.description: Longest gap between runs before the watchdog calls it missed. null for event or manual-only.

args.description: celery_task only: positional arguments run-now passes, the same as the beat entry (AUT-74).

kwargs.description: celery_task only: keyword arguments run-now passes, the same as the beat entry (AUT-74). A string "$setting:<name>" is read from the backend settings when the run starts.

source_path.description: Repo-relative path (a path:line suffix is allowed) where the automation is defined.
